expected.subject: homeassistant.components.*
expected.justification: ADR-0004: 'We no longer accept any new integration that relies on webscraping', with the Context naming 'PhantomJS or other headless browsers' as webscraping mechanisms; selenium (browser automation for scraping) is reliance on webscraping inside a core integration, and neither exception clause (generic HTML-parsing integrations; extracting fields from forms during authentication) covers browser automation

expected.subject: homeassistant.components.*
expected.justification: ADR-0019: 'We no longer accept integrations that integrate with devices over GPIO' and 'We identify, deprecate and remove integrations that use GPIO'; gpiozero is the GPIO access library, so a core integration importing it is a GPIO integration pending removal, and only custom integrations (outside homeassistant.components) may keep using GPIO
